# PayStage

> PayStage is a safety layer for AI agent payments. It answers one question before money moves: should this payment happen? Preflight checks for x402 and MCP return a verdict of `pay`, `review`, or `do_not_pay`.

Status: Tool #1 — MCP payment preflight — **Available now** on npm as `@paystage/preflight` version `0.1.0`.

## Install

```
npx @paystage/preflight
```

Non-interactive:

```
npx -y @paystage/preflight
```

## Links

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paystage/preflight
- GitHub: https://github.com/base-buzz/paystage
- Website: https://paystage.xyz
- README: https://github.com/base-buzz/paystage#readme
- server.json (raw): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/base-buzz/paystage/main/server.json
- MCP Registry name: `xyz.paystage/preflight`

## What it does

`@paystage/preflight` is a stdio MCP server. Given a proposed x402 payment (amount, asset, network, payee), it evaluates the payment against a local policy file and returns one of three verdicts:

- `pay` — within policy; the agent may proceed.
- `review` — outside auto-approve bounds; a human or higher-level check should decide.
- `do_not_pay` — violates policy; the agent must not sign.

The verdict is returned before the agent signs anything.

## Policy

The policy file is JSON. PayStage uses snake_case keys. Example:

```
{
  "version": 1,
  "max_amount": { "value": "1.00", "asset": "USDC", "decimals": 6 },
  "allowed_pay_to": ["0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C"],
  "allowed_networks": ["eip155:8453", "eip155:84532"],
  "unknown_payee": "review"
}
```

Fields:

- `version` — policy schema version (currently `1`).
- `max_amount` — maximum single payment. `value` is a decimal string, `asset` is the asset symbol, `decimals` is the asset's decimal precision.
- `allowed_pay_to` — explicit allowlist of payee addresses.
- `allowed_networks` — CAIP-2 network identifiers. `eip155:8453` is Base mainnet; `eip155:84532` is Base Sepolia.
- `unknown_payee` — verdict to return when the payee is not in `allowed_pay_to`. One of `pay`, `review`, `do_not_pay`.

## Verdicts

- `pay`
- `review`
- `do_not_pay`

## Client configuration

Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`):

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "paystage-preflight": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@paystage/preflight"],
      "env": {
        "PAYSTAGE_POLICY_PATH": "/absolute/path/to/policy.json"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`):

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "paystage-preflight": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@paystage/preflight"],
      "env": {
        "PAYSTAGE_POLICY_PATH": "/absolute/path/to/policy.json"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Set `PAYSTAGE_POLICY_PATH` to the absolute path of your policy file.
